analysis_status: Specified before computing Phase 3 tests and confidence intervals. Exploratory analyses informed by Phase 1 and Phase 2 descriptions of the same extract.

sampling_model.unit: One participant, using the single supplied UDS record and the single supplied MRI record
sampling_model.target: Means and contrasts in the source population represented by the teaching extract, conditional on each stated eligibility rule.
sampling_model.assumptions: Participant observations are treated as independent under the sampling model.
sampling_model.scope: The sampling frame and selection probabilities are undocumented. Confidence intervals depend on the sampling assumptions and the stated eligibility rules.
sampling_model.visit_rule: Use the supplied record for each participant. Clinical visit date and number, scan date and the interval between measurements are unavailable.
sampling_model.value_rules: Reuse the Phase 1 usability rules and sample flags. Retain measurements outside IQR review fences.

paired_normal.use: Mean score, mean thickness, sampling distributions and the score contrast across MRI groups

status_and_mri.use: Supplementary comparison of mean MRI thickness across all four UDS cognitive status groups

mri_grouping.source: Pooled median in the Phase 2 status_and_mri sample
mri_grouping.comparison_order: At or above cutoff minus below cutoff
mri_grouping.ties: Include values equal to the cutoff in the at-or-above group
mri_grouping.bootstrap_rule: Keep the cutoff fixed across bootstrap draws

mean_score.parameter: Population mean ANIMALS score under the paired_normal eligibility rules
mean_score.standard_interval: Two-sided Student t interval for a mean using sample SD / sqrt(n)

mean_thickness.parameter: Population mean left inferior parietal cortical thickness under the paired_normal rules
mean_thickness.standard_interval: Two-sided Student t interval for a mean using sample SD / sqrt(n)

score_difference_by_mri.parameter: Mean score at or above the cutoff minus mean score below the cutoff
score_difference_by_mri.estimator: Difference between the two independent-group sample means
score_difference_by_mri.standard_interval: Welch t interval using Satterthwaite degrees of freedom

thickness_by_status.parameter: The four population mean thicknesses defined by UDS cognitive status
thickness_by_status.estimator: Arithmetic mean within each cognitive status group
thickness_by_status.standard_interval: Separate Student t intervals for the group means

score_difference_by_mri.role: Main Phase 3 cross-modal contrast in the normal-cognition sample
score_difference_by_mri.null: The mean score difference between the MRI groups is zero
score_difference_by_mri.alternative: The mean score difference between the MRI groups is nonzero
score_difference_by_mri.effect: Raw difference in mean score with its confidence interval

thickness_by_status.role: Supplementary omnibus cross-modal comparison across cognitive groups
thickness_by_status.null: All four mean thicknesses are equal
thickness_by_status.alternative: At least one mean thickness differs
thickness_by_status.effect: Group means and descriptive sample eta-squared, computed from sums of squares
thickness_by_status.diagnostics: Review each group's size, distribution, spread and extreme values. Keep the seven-person impairment-without-MCI group with an explicit precision limitation.

testing_policy.adjustment: Holm adjustment across the two planned tests
testing_policy.reporting: Report the test statistic, degrees of freedom, raw p-value and Holm-adjusted p-value

bootstrap.confidence_interval: Percentile interval with linear interpolation at the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles

whole_sample.draw_rule: Resample n complete participant rows with replacement
whole_sample.purpose: Show sampling distributions and empirical standard errors. Compare the thickness mean's bootstrap interval with the t interval, given the lower-tail asymmetry seen in Phase 2.

mri_contrast.draw_rule: Resample complete participant rows with replacement separately within the two MRI groups, preserving each group's observed size.
mri_contrast.comparison: Compare the bootstrap percentile interval with the Welch interval

interpretation.confidence_interval: Under repeated sampling with the stated assumptions, a nominal 95% procedure covers the target population parameter in about 95% of repeated samples.
interpretation.p_value: Under the null hypothesis and test assumptions, the probability of a test statistic at least as incompatible with the null as the observed statistic.
interpretation.practical_importance: Interpret the raw effect and interval width in their measurement units.
interpretation.phase_four: Estimate the adjusted score difference per 0.1 mm using age, sex and education in Phase 4.
